name: Tatevik Petrosyan
title: UX/UI Designer Crafting Digital Products & Platforms
bio: My journey started in interior design, where I learned how people move through spaces, interact with their environment, and feel inside it. That mindset naturally evolved into UX/UI design—because today, people don’t just live in physical spaces, they live in digital ones too. Our phones, dashboards, and tools have become rooms we enter every day.
bioExtended: With over a decade of experience at Synopsys, I designed user experiences for highly technical EDA products such as Custom Compiler, Opto Compiler, WaveView, and other enterprise chip design tools used globally. My focus is on transforming complex workflows into clear, usable interfaces through structured systems, scalable UI patterns, and well-considered interactions that support mission-critical work.
certifications: Microsoft Innovation Center - UX/UI Design Course
